# 4 bedroom semi-detached house for sale

> In a highly sought residential location near amenities and north east of the City Centre, an extended home which offers four bedrooms and immaculately presented accommodation, including two reception areas, a conservatory and kitchen. The property backs onto 'The Quarry' and has excellent parking to the front, a private garden at the rear and useful garage with utility area off.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bedrooms
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Lokalita: Quarry Road, Hereford
- Cena: £350,000
